findings.title: Indexed access for ID/COMPANY_STATE predicate unverified
findings.description: Whether COMPANY has an index on ID or (ID, COMPANY_STATE) is unconfirmed from static review.
findings.recommendation: Confirm an index on COMPANY(ID) or (ID, COMPANY_STATE) for keyed single-row deletes.

findings.title: No transaction boundary in mapper
findings.description: Atomicity and rollback of the delete depend entirely on the caller-provided transaction.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the delete in an explicit transaction at the service layer.

findings.title: Affected-row count not surfaced
findings.description: Callers cannot distinguish a successful delete from a no-match delete because the return value is not consumed.
findings.recommendation: Consume the mapper return value and treat zero affected rows as a no-match case.
